div.head: VI Atr 32.2
div.ab: ⁊ gemeta ⁊ gewihta rihte man georne, ⁊ ælces unrihtes heonan forð geswice.
And gemeta ⁊ gewihta rihte man georne, ⁊ ælces unrihtes heonan forð geswice.
⁊ gemeta ⁊ gewihta rihte man georne, ⁊ ælces unrihtes heonan forð geswice.
And gemeta and gewihta rihte man georne, and ælces unrihtes heonan forð geswice.
Und Maasse und Gewichte mache man genau richtig, und lasse hinfort von jedem Unrechte ab.
And let measures and weights be carefully corrected, and let all injustice cease henceforth.
And weights and measures shall be corrected with all diligence, and an end put to all unjust practices.
And weights and measures are to be assiduously made right, and all unlawful practices abolished henceforth.

note.seg: Selbst wo Weltliches über V Atr hinaus ausgeführt wird, fehlt doch Strafdrohung.—Diese Einschaltung aus Eg scheint weniger authentisch als V Atr; s. o. Einl. 2 F. 11
Even where secular matters are elaborated beyond V Atr, a threat of penalty is nevertheless lacking.—This insertion from Eg seems less authentic than V Atr; see above Introduction 2 F. 11
